summary: Implemented every stub in babel/core.py (get_global, Locale.default/negotiate/parse, the display-name and locale-data properties, default_locale, negotiate_locale, parse_locale, get_locale_identifier) and restored the missing private Locale._data accessor; also fixed a 3.12-only nested f-string in __repr__ that broke import on this 3.10 interpreter. The last full-suite run (c0-test tests) was interrupted at collection with 14 errors because babel/localedata.py is still an unimplemented stub, so no tests executed; against an in-memory localedata and plural shim (not written to disk), tests/test_core.py gave 58 passed plus all 1013 all-locales cases, with only test_plural_form_property failing on the shim's placeholder PluralRule.
